_doc: Index presentation arc — industry examples → landscape → brief mechanics → substantiated proposal. Consumed by analysis_writing.json, voice_guide.json, deploy agents, index TOC. Reference: contract/INDEX_NARRATIVE_SCHEDULE.md.

reference.pattern: Industry analogy first · map the landscape · explain mechanics briefly · then substantiate argument and proposal

beat_sequence: industry_example — name a competitor, facility, or parallel market (who writes what form, what trigger)
analogy — grid reform vs insurance capacity; cat/cyber vs grid geography
landscape_map — value chain layer or universe scatter; dot is posture not hazard
mechanics_brief — peril mechanism + scoring frame in ≤2 screens; no methodology dump
substantiate — magnitude, model failure, economics with cites
proposal — instrument + commercial turn; never summary bullets
grammar.industry_rule: Every thesis section opens with who in the market is already moving — then why the form still misses.
grammar.landscape_rule: Map before you score: layers table or scatter must precede the Margin of Safety argument.
grammar.mechanics_rule: Technical content serves the proposal — E×P frame, interruption ≠ damage, evidence tiers; stop before the full case.
grammar.proposal_rule: Three claims + one instrument; close on whitespace and who can carry the unpriced peril.
grammar.viz_rule: Scatter follows Act II landscape prose; rankings follow Act IV proposal.
grammar.honest_provisional: State PROVISIONAL/measured share once at data handoff
